query:
UPDATE workspaces w SET owner_id = $2
             WHERE w.id = $1
               AND NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members wm JOIN users u ON u.id = wm.user_id
                    WHERE wm.workspace_id = w.id AND wm.user_id = w.owner_id
                      AND wm.role = 'owner' AND u.status = 'active'
               )
